description: This Java class 'ThreadSnapshotParser' parses thread snapshot data from Android VM traces, extracting thread attributes, stack frames, and lock states.

classes.name: ThreadSnapshot
classes.description: Data structure to hold parsed thread information including attributes, stack frames, and locks.

classes.name: StackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Base class for representing a generic stack frame.

classes.name: NativeStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a native code stack frame.

classes.name: KernelStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a kernel mode stack frame.

classes.name: JavaStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a Java or JNI stack frame.

classes.name: LockSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a lock object, including its state (locked, waiting, sleeping).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a Lines object containing thread trace data and returns a ThreadSnapshot object representing the thread’s state.
